name: Quest Diagnostics
verdict: WAIT-on-price (quality name, no margin of safety at ATH). CLEAN business, honest disclosure, but ~19.6x fwd adj / ~4-turn premium to LabCorp for a ~9% grower. Prob-wtd FV $204 = -3% vs spot. Stage a starter on a pullback, not here.
quality_read: GENUINELY high-quality operationally: ROTC ~28% on tangible invested capital, FCF conversion 137% of NI, FCF margin 12.3%, top-5 payer only 20% (none >10%), 15yr div-raise streak, IG balance sheet. BUT GAAP returns ordinary (ROE 13.8%, ROIC ~9%) because ~$8.9B goodwill + $5.7B debt from the roll-up depress the accounting capital base; tangible common equity NEGATIVE (-$1.8B). ROE/PB tie-out exact: 13.8%/3.31x = 4.18% = 1/23.9x.
sizing: Target starter ~$10-15k = ~1-1.5% of the $1mm intended base (real-money feasible now vs $446k live NLV; fits the interim ~$700k gross cap). NOT to be entered at spot.
entry_band: GTC BUY 60sh @ $189 (fills ~$11.3k). Level = ~17.6x fwd adj = base-case-fair minus ~7% MoS, roughly the 52w-low-to-mid zone (52w low $163.76 = 15.3x, an overshoot floor). Escalate to a full ~$15k starter (75-80sh) only if it prints $180-183 (~16.8-17.0x fwd adj) OR a Q2/Q3-26 organic-volume BEAT re-accelerates the growth case at any price <=$200. Do NOT chase >$210.

policy_read.pama_clfs: Category-b overhang (perennially delayed, NOT a live FY26 hit, NOT permanently killed). CY2026 = 0% cut, frozen by CAA-2026 sec6226 (P.L. 119-75, signed Feb-3-2026; 6th cut-delay). Cut resumes Jan-1-2027 capped 15%/yr for 2027-2029 off fresh H1-2025 data. RESULTS Act (HR5269/S2761) pending in committee, would freeze CLFS at 2025 levels thru 2028 (zero floor action). Pure-CLFS exposure ~7-9% of rev -> worst-case 15% cut = ~1.0-1.3% rev headwind, likely less. TRIMS not breaks.
policy_read.diversifies_cigna: YES confirmed. Different agency (CMS lab benefit vs PBM/pharmacy rules), different mechanism (fee-schedule rate-setting vs drug rebate/spread), different political vector. Genuinely orthogonal to CI's drug-pricing/PBM policy risk.
policy_read.obbba: New disclosed risk (July 2025): Medicaid/ACA changes, NOT CLFS. Medicaid ~8% of consolidated rev. Watch but secondary.

biggest_risk: Multiple de-rate toward LabCorp parity (~15-16x fwd). If organic volume normalizes from the current 9% (COVID-comp + LifeLabs-lapping flattered) back toward the structural 3-4% AND the market stops paying a premium to LH, fair value compresses to ~$170-180 (-15 to -19%). This is a valuation/positioning risk, not a business-quality risk.
tripwire: Q2-2026 (~late-July) and Q3-2026 ORGANIC requisition-volume growth. If organic volume decelerates below ~5% for two consecutive quarters (toward the structural 3-4% base), the re-rating premium is unsupported -> the WAIT hardens and the GTC level drops toward $175. If organic HOLDS >=7%, the premium is earned and a <=$200 pullback becomes a stage.
verified_findings: All primary-sourced. Revenue/NI/margins/debt/equity/goodwill/shares tie to FY25 10-K (filed 2026-02-26) + Q1-26 10-Q + Q4-25 8-K EX-99.1. Gross margin RECOMPUTED 33.2% (stale XBRL tag ignored). No goodwill impairment; DIS single reporting unit. Payer concentration VERIFIED benign. PAMA status VERIFIED to the enrolled statute. Filed diluted EPS is $8.75 (not $8.78).
note_data_corrections: Corrected during DD: (1) filed FY25 diluted EPS $8.75 not $8.78; (2) FY25 adj EPS $9.85 (release), not my initial $9.10 estimate; (3) FY26 guide was RAISED at Q1-26 (adj $10.63-10.83 vs original $10.50-10.70); (4) 'Government payers' 17% of DIS reconciles to ~11% US Medicare+Medicaid + ~5% Canada(LifeLabs) — not a single 16% Medicare figure.
